2. Email Gen — Quick Start

No retailer pool is required. Follow these steps whenever you want new emails:

  1. Choose your inbox. Enter the Gmail (or other) address where you want messages delivered in the forwarding destination field above. Complete Cloudflare's one-time verification if requested.
  2. Generate emails. Choose a quantity below and click Generate Only. Your new addresses are safely saved, without any retailer assignment or live forwarding rule.
  3. Set up forwarding. For large batches, use one verified Cloudflare catch-all destination instead of making an individual rule for every email.
  4. Check delivery. Use Test Email Delivery. An address is verified only after a real message reaches the selected inbox.

You can stop after Step 2 and export saved addresses. Adding them to Target, Walmart, Pokémon Center, Costco or Sam's Club is entirely optional.

Email Gen saves addresses locally first. Forwarding and retailer assignment are separate actions. Cloudflare standard Email Routing supports up to 200 individual rules per domain; a catch-all rule can cover additional addresses without creating one rule per email. Failed and unverified emails stay saved, not marked working.

Choose the correct file: Export Email Gen CSV contains profile_name,email,password with aco gen 1, aco gen 2 and the requested import-only password Freeshit1!. The Shikari Profile CSV/TXT exports match your existing Shikari file's 24 exact columns beginning with index,profile_name,first_name,last_name,email, with sequential names and original emails. The original Shikari profile format has no password column, so it will not import that preset password. Address, name, phone, and payment fields are left blank unless you complete real Target profiles first. The .txt choice is for Shikari file pickers that don't select .csv; it is still comma-delimited. Both files are plaintext; protect them. Neither creates a real retailer account or mailbox password.

Step 3 — Forward unlimited-style aliases with Catch-all

Recommended when you have hundreds of generated emails. Cloudflare only allows 200 individual forwarding rules per domain. A catch-all rule receives mail to addresses with no matching individual rule and forwards it to one verified inbox, without creating hundreds of extra rules.

  1. Open Cloudflare Dashboard and select your sng.sarl domain.
  2. Open Email Routing → Routing Rules → Catch-all address.
  3. Choose Send to an email (Forward), select your verified forwarding inbox, and save the catch-all rule.
  4. Return here and enable the catch-all verification checkbox in Step 4. Only email addresses with actual inbox delivery receipts are marked working.

Important: Catch-all forwards messages sent to any unmatched address at your domain, even typos and addresses you did not generate. It does not replace or delete existing specific rules. Review the destination before enabling it. ACO Studio does not enable catch-all automatically.

Advanced — Create individual Cloudflare rules (200/domain maximum)

Use this only when you need an exact address-specific rule. If Cloudflare reports HTTP 429 or Limit Exceeded, stop: more attempts will not bypass the provider's domain rule limit.

Optional — Add saved emails to a retailer pool

Leave this alone if you want to keep your addresses outside all retailer pools. When selected, this applies to all currently unassigned generated emails. Only verified, working addresses are actually imported into the retailer's unused pool.

Advanced: Change the forwarding inbox for existing drafts

Change forwarding inbox on existing drafts

Keep every generated @sng.sarl address. Change only random-generated DRAFT aliases with no published Cloudflare rule or retailer import. Live, pending, manually created, and imported accounts are not changed. Preview and explicitly confirm before saving an encrypted backup and changing the destination.

All original aliases, retailer assignments, and stored data remain. An encrypted snapshot is preserved first. No Cloudflare rules are published by this action.

Step 4 — Test Email Delivery

Use a separate sending email account to verify a real message reaches your forwarding inbox. Only receipt-confirmed addresses are marked working. In catch-all mode, test up to 25 unverified saved addresses per click to avoid overwhelming your email provider.

Advanced mail settings (Gmail defaults)

The app reports PASSED only when a unique test message is found in your verified IMAP INBOX. SMTP accepted, pending verification, undelivered, or untested are not a pass. Both test passwords are cleared after each run.

All generated emails remain in your encrypted Email Bank until you decide otherwise. Forwarding is optional, and retailer pool assignment is optional. Only Cloudflare-confirmed live addresses with a successful inbox delivery test can enter the Personal retailer Unused email pool. Existing manual aliases are not changed.
